why: The October 2026 tasks run node ./public/fonts/fa-solid-300.ttf, and a second loader uses fa-solid.lkf with no weight. The task-command pattern named only .woff2 with a three-digit weight, so neither matched. It now takes any font or fake-font extension, with or without the weight (ADR-0065). Running node on a font has no innocent reading; a script handed a font name, or a fa-solid.js file, is ordinary and is not matched.
